title: Morten Rand-Hendriksen: CSS Grid Changes Everything (About Web Layouts)
summary: Morten Rand-Hendriksen argues that CSS Grid changes web layout, showing how to place content in cells independent of HTML source order and reshape layouts with media queries. It makes the case for using Grid now that browsers support it.
why: HN commenters say it convinced them to drop other layout approaches and embrace Grid, and cite its advice on fallbacks for older browsers.

quote.text: it has convinced me to stop using other layouts/frameworks and just embrace grid
